explanation: The Almighty Ruler who demonstrates His justice through the seven plagues and governs the end of world history.
Seven heavenly beings receive seven bowls containing God's final wrath against evil in the world.
Objects filled with the completed judgment that are poured out on the earth to punish the ungodly.
The seven great afflictions and catastrophes that strike those who have taken the mark of the beast, including sores, water turned to blood, and darkness.
The devil's power or the evil system on earth that opposes God and persecutes believers.
False gods or images worshipped instead of the true God before judgment falls.
The sky above the sea, often used symbolically to represent chaos or the wicked realm now cleansing itself through fire and blood.
The intense element representing God's cleansing wrath and destruction of all evil in the final plagues.
The heavenly sanctuary where God dwells, filled with His glory and smoke from His majesty when judgment is completed.
